hints.title: Key Insight and Observation
hints.text: A box must have capacity at least as large as the largest individual package weight.

hints.title: Algorithmic Strategy and State
hints.text: Find the maximum weight among all packages.

hints.title: Optimal Boundary and Processing
hints.text: Filter box capacities greater than or equal to that maximum and return the minimum among them.

hints.title: Complete Implementation
hints.text:
```python
def minCapacityBox(packages: list[int], boxes: list[int]) -> int:
    max_p = max(packages)
    valid = [b for b in boxes if b >= max_p]
    return min(valid) if valid else -1
```

complexity.notes: Finds the package maximum and scans box options in linear time.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Sorting both lists is slower than single linear passes.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Identifies the bottleneck package size directly.
